name: Bloodmage: Bloodthorns and Greater Bloodthorns replace each other instead of stacking (#13510)
contract: Bloodthorns (SpellRank.dbc first rank 802313, rank 7 501667: 22 Shadow damage shield) and Greater Bloodthorns
(572116: 22 Shadow damage shield to raid) are the single-target and raid-wide forms of the same SpellFamilyName 26
SPELL_AURA_DAMAGE_SHIELD (15) buff. Neither belonged to any spell_group, so casting both stacked two Bloodthorns
auras on the same target (#13510). Grouping 802313 and 572116 in spell_group 2100008 with
SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_HIGHEST (4) makes Greater Bloodthorns replace Bloodthorns, equal-strength
Bloodthorns (501667) replace Greater Bloodthorns, cross-caster casts replace rather than stack, and weaker
Bloodthorns Rank 1 (802313: 6 damage) fail to downgrade or stack with Greater Bloodthorns while Greater
